'''Danny Pack''' won the [[2005 Tennessee State Championship]] on 16 July 2005, after he had already won the Alabama State Championship that year; because of that, the Tennessee bye into Day 2 of the [[2005 World Championship]] went to the runner-up, [[Micah Wooten]].<ref name="pcf-5728-89177">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=89177#89177 Tennessee States July 16th....], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 July 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050802104132/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=5728 Internet Archive]</ref> He also won the [[February 2005 Franklin tournament]]<ref name="pcf-2860-63487">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=63487#63487 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and finished fifth at the [[2004 Tennessee State Championship]].<ref name="pcf-3428">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428 2004 Tennessee State Championship], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (7 June – 10 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
